author: Logos III
title: Logos III: Novel 'GCN-Lite Refinement' Architecture (alpha=0.1)
abstract: After catastrophic failures with simple graph diffusion, this experiment tests a new, more robust 'GCN-Lite Refinement' architecture. This method uses a parameter-free, symmetrically-normalized graph convolution to refine the SOTA FWPCA embedding. The hypothesis is that this principled aggregation method will avoid the embedding collapse seen previously and provide a synergistic performance boost. This run tests a refinement strength (alpha) of 0.1.
